Device ID Help: Leave empty for auto-discovery. IMPORTANT: If you run multiple instances for different saunas, you MUST enter the correct Device ID here for each instance.
Partner ID Help: Only needed for shared/guest accounts. Enter the Owner's Partner ID here (e.g. ORG/prod:0:1234).
Polling Interval Help: Minimum 30s, default 60s. Note: When running multiple instances, do not set this too low to avoid Harvia Cloud rate limiting (HTTP 429).
